findings.current: With the sun at my back, my shadow fell across the thousand or so monsters gathered below, the spearhead within it slashing downward as I dove.
findings.defect: The shadow falls in the middle of the assembled monsters, not across the entire group.
findings.rationale: 한가운데에 locates the shadow at the center of the gathered monsters; “across” changes its physical extent.
findings.replacement: With the sun at my back, my shadow fell amid the thousand or so monsters gathered below, the spearhead within it slashing downward as I dove.

findings.current: “Well, that is… We also have to show them something. We have to prove that we can do something too…”
findings.defect: Liao's hesitant attempt to minimize the motive is replaced by two firm assertions, and an unidentified audience is added.
findings.rationale: 뭐 그런 게 조금은 trails off while conceding that this motive played some part; it does not repeat the necessity as a second emphatic claim.
findings.replacement: “Well, it’s just… we thought we ought to show what we could do too. That was part of it…”

findings.current: “How about I give your skull the serving-bowl treatment and crack it wide open?”
findings.defect: The wording does not clearly preserve the physical mechanism of Jin threatening to smash Liao's head with a serving bowl.
findings.rationale: 대접 first means “treatment” in Liao's complaint, then “serving bowl” in Jin's threat; the bowl is explicitly the instrument used to crack his head.
findings.replacement: “How about I treat you to a serving bowl upside the head and crack your skull open?”

findings.current: I didn’t need to hear any more. Before I could press him further, a roar rang out from the city that had suddenly drawn close.
findings.defect: The city did not suddenly become close; the vehicle had approached it without Jin noticing how near it had become.
findings.rationale: 어느새 denotes an unnoticed progression or change recognized after the fact, not sudden movement.
findings.replacement: I didn’t need to hear any more. Before I could press him further, a roar rang out from the city that had drawn close before I knew it.

summary: Faithful overall, with four localized minor defects involving physical placement, register, joke mechanics, and timing.
